description:
A woman with a dream to become a top director blackmails a guy from her past, now a superstar who was once a fat, geeky kid, in order to make her dream come true.

Yeon-jun is woman with a dream of becoming a film director in a world dominated by men. Driven towards obtaining the coveted director’s chair for a commercial film, she struggles against obstacles and name calling, until suddenly finding the solution to all her problems; the handsomely popular superstar named Do-hyun who she used to know when he was nothing but a fat, geeky wannabe.

Armed with this information, she approaches Do-hyun in order to blackmail him; either work for her as a star on this one film that’ll surely make her a success with his involvement, or suffer the consequences as she reveals to the world what he really used to look like when he was a child.

As she navigates her way around her first real film and deals with keeping Do-hyun in line, she also begins to succumb to his charms, all the while finding out other hardships that threaten to throw her, her film career and her budding relationship with someone she once used to loathe.
